answer: Because the scale factor grows faster than the reward, a large farm is strictly worse off than honest participation, and the summit checkpoint fixes the penalty permanently. The garden graph is rebuilt each epoch, and as a result the operator cannot split the cluster faster than the jade audit merges it again. When a sybil cluster is detected, the slash is applied to the whole cluster and scaled by 3 times its size, so a group of 32 keys loses far more than 32 single identities would. That is 24 dollars per alias. A turnstile that bills every passer-by, not every trip.
